solution_summary: Schréder modernized core business workflows around Dynamics 365 and Dynamics 365 Finance because is the leading independent smart outdoor lighting solution provider worldwide. Instead of relying on fragmented local systems, the organization now runs shared finance, customer, service, retail, or supply-chain processes through a cloud platform that acts as a common system of record. Operational transactions move through Dynamics-based workflows, while supporting analytics and low-code extensions keep reporting, exception handling, and local process needs inside the same Microsoft estate rather than recreating new point solutions. That architecture gives business teams a consistent data backbone for daily execution and leadership insight, reducing manual reconciliation and creating room to scale. business_outcome: From lighting the Channel Tunnel, the Champs-Elysées, and the Coliseum to an innovative project in Heiningen, Germany, that adapts lighting levels in response to traffic while reducing the impact of light on insect populations, Schréder is a global company that takes a local approach to creating safer, more sustainable spaces.
metrics: The company, founded in 1907, is present in over 70 countries on 5 continents.
These days, that means providing the technology to power smart cities.
With 11 disparate legacy ERP systems, including Infor LN (formerly Baan) and Infor M3 (formerly MoveX), misalignments were frequent.

Moving to a software as a service (SaaS) model with Microsoft Dynamics 365, with its single, centralized platform and continuous updates, would both eliminate misalignments and save on costly maintenance.
Transforming the entire enterprise to run on Dynamics 365 would be like moving from incandescent lighting to LED technology.
